AC-000003.assertion: Nari is a low-status but skilled apprentice sky-reader.

AC-000011.assertion: Master Orem recognizes danger through inherited warning, office, and fear.

AC-000016.assertion: Master Orem protects the inherited explanatory order when persistent anomalous evidence threatens it. His failure mode is institutional certainty hardened into dogma: he initially treats contradiction as error or danger rather than as reason to revise the prevailing model.

AC-000017.assertion: Nari privileges repeated observation and evidence over doctrine. When evidence survives careful checking, she treats the prevailing model as potentially incomplete, while not assuming that better evidence grants ultimate comprehension.
